column2: [intro]
In a cup, the infusion’s made,
Leaves blend, a sweet scent displayed,
A solemn moment, a ritual parade,
Tea isn’t rock ‘n’ roll, but it’s well-played.
Tea, it’s not sexy, it's true,
Yet it warms us with each brew,
Forget the bias, let it woo,
Tea, an ignored delight, it needs its due.
In vibrant hues, green or black,
It caresses lips, we keep coming back,
A potent remedy, with health in its track,
Tea, no one should lack.
Tea, it’s not sexy, it's true,
Yet it warms us with each brew,
Forget the bias, let it woo,
Tea, an ignored delight, it needs its due.
[ solo ]
Tea is good, there’s no doubt,
Despite its calm image, it makes us shout,
Open your mind, drink it all out,
Tea, we adore, can't live without!
[ outro ]
